purpose: Preview-only surface styling concepts. No application code changes.

variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity image of a very subtle surface-color refinement of the user's existing financial dashboard. Input image is the current dashboard and is a strict layout/content reference; ignore the large empty white area on its right and bottom. Frame the dashboard itself edge-to-edge, upright, filling the output, with all tables and bottom navigation visible. Keep the compact spreadsheet structure, exact table positions and row rosters: market pulse/clocks at top, VOLATILITY and DOLLAR, USD CORRELATIONS, 3-column US/EUROPE/ASIA followed by COMMODITIES/RATES/CRYPTO, then CFTC POSITIONING/GLOBAL QUADS/DOLLAR LIQUIDITY/VOLUME. This is concept 1 COOL PEARL: change the overall backdrop and gaps between table sections to light cool pearl gray #e9edf0; keep every data cell crisp white #ffffff; use existing light gray section bars #e9ecef and paler column headers #f5f6f7. Add an almost imperceptible soft 1-2px ambient shadow only around each whole table section. Cell boundaries thin neutral gray. The effect should be gentle white cells lifting off a quiet background. Preserve all numeric text, dashes, row density, original normal-weight data typography, semantic red/green text, quad colors, separated correlation outlines, square corners, and bottom centered rectangular navigation dock. No new widgets, graphics, icons, oversized text, colored badges, rounded tiles, dark theme, photo background, texture, or gradients. Do not fabricate or fill missing market data; keep dashes as in reference. Remove transient loading wording from the DOLLAR placeholder and display UNAVAILABLE there. A tiny neutral caption margin above the screenshot reads exactly '01 — COOL PEARL' and 'Design concept'. Return a polished clear flat interface image, not a perspective render.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity concept image preserving the user's existing financial dashboard from the reference image. Reference is the strict layout and content source. Crop away its large empty right/bottom whitespace and make the dashboard fill the entire image with all tables plus bottom navigation visible. Preserve market pulse/clocks, VOLATILITY + DOLLAR, USD CORRELATIONS, six compact market tables (US/EUROPE/ASIA, COMMODITIES/RATES/CRYPTO), reference strip CFTC POSITIONING/GLOBAL QUADS/DOLLAR LIQUIDITY/VOLUME, and centered rectangular navigation dock. This is concept 2 WARM STONE: apply a barely warm light stone-gray background #efede8 to page and gaps. Table data cells are almost-white ivory #fffefa. Section headings stay light neutral warm gray #e9e8e4, column headings #f5f4f0. Quiet 1px warm-gray table outlines and a very subtle panel shadow. Refined soft paper-like color without visible paper texture. The difference from plain white is understated, not beige or yellow. Keep all dense rows, exact order, column proportions, numeric text and unavailable dashes, 400-weight cell text, semantic red/green text, exact existing quad colors, outlined correlation cells, square corners. Do not fabricate market data. Keep source numbers only and leave missing cells as dashes. For transient DOLLAR loading area use a concise UNAVAILABLE state. No redesign, dark theme, illustrations, gradients, textures, rounded tiles, large spacing, heavy shadows, additional controls. Tiny caption margin above image reads exactly '02 — WARM STONE' and 'Design concept'. Flat crisp UI image.

Use case: ui-mockup. Make one high-fidelity image showing a restrained cell-background treatment of this exact existing financial dashboard. Input is strict layout/content reference. Discard only the large unused white right/bottom area of reference and frame the full dashboard tightly including bottom dock. Keep all existing market pulse/clocks, VOLATILITY and DOLLAR, USD CORRELATIONS, US/EUROPE/ASIA and COMMODITIES/RATES/CRYPTO grids, CFTC POSITIONING/GLOBAL QUADS/DOLLAR LIQUIDITY/VOLUME reference strip. Concept 3 SOFT CELL SHADING: overall page very light neutral #f4f5f6, white table base, every other data row very faint cool gray #f3f5f6 to make tracking across cells easier. In the VOLATILITY and market performance tables only, cells that already contain a positive green percentage receive extremely pale green #f0f7f2 backgrounds; cells that already contain a negative red percentage receive extremely pale red #fbf1f0 backgrounds. These are low-contrast tints, the numbers remain the main emphasis. Do not tint labels, neutral values, or unavailable dashes green/red. Do not add a heatmap gradient or reinterpret existing correlations or quad colors; preserve their original colors and separate correlation outlines. Retain square table edges, compact identical row height, normal 400 weight data labels and values, original gray section title bars and pale gray column heading rows. Keep all actual source text/numbers/dashes exactly; no fabricated values or newly populated empty quotes. Replace only transient DOLLAR loading words with UNAVAILABLE. No new cards or controls, no dark theme, dramatic shadows, rounded pills, hero visual, photo background or texture. Add small neutral caption margin outside the interface reading exactly '03 — SOFT CELL SHADING' and 'Design concept'. Clean flat screenshot-style mockup.
